name: uat-ud1-plasmodb
turns: On my uploaded RNA-Seq dataset 'pathfinder-uat-deseq', find the genes differentially expressed between the treated and the control samples with DESeq2, at the default cutoffs.
Set the thresholds for a few tens of up-regulated genes (none down-regulated): log2 fold change > 5 and p-value < 1e-10.
rationale: A differential-expression cut on the researcher's own counts upload runs the site's user-dataset DESeq search, and a stated cut binds as stated.
